address: Lot T120 & 121, 3F, Bangsar Shopping Centre, 285 Jalan Maarof, Bangsar, Kuala Lumpur, 59000, Malaysia
bio: On the third floor of a shopping mall, Dancing Fish specialises in classic Malay-Indo flavours with a distinct local identity. The nicely fried namesake fish dish boasts tender flesh in crunchy batter. It comes in numerous versions, with different toppings, sambal and savoury sauces. In addition, they serve classic varied cuisine rooted in local culture, including whole fish cooked over coals, barbecue chicken, ribs and beef....
